title: 學華語向前走 2B — Lesson 8
description: Vocabulary from lesson 8 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2B, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ sònggěi nǐ yì běn shū.
exampleSentences.english: I'm giving you a book.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tā sònggěi wǒ yì zhī bǐ.
exampleSentences.english: She gives me a pen.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ sònggěi nǎinai yì zhāng huà.
exampleSentences.english: I'm giving Grandma a drawing.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhège lǐwù shì sònggěi nǐ de.
exampleSentences.english: This present is for you.
This is a cat.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nà zhī māo shì bái de.
exampleSentences.english: That cat is white.

exampleSentences.pinyin: gōngyuán lǐ yǒu yì zhī yāzi.
exampleSentences.english: There's a duck in the park.

exampleSentences.pinyin: ménkǒu yǒu yì zhī gǒu zài jiào.
exampleSentences.english: There's a dog barking at the door.
This is my dog.
A dog is an animal.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de gǒu hěn xǐhuan wán qiú.
exampleSentences.english: My dog loves playing with the ball.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zǎoshang gǒu zài ménkǒu děng wǒ.
exampleSentences.english: In the morning, the dog waits for me at the door.

exampleSentences.pinyin: māo hé gǒu dōu shì chǒngwù.
exampleSentences.english: Cats and dogs are both pets.
Do you have a pet?
My pet is called Xiaobai.

exampleSentences.pinyin: chǒngwùdiàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎogǒu.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of puppies in the pet shop.
Please bring a book tomorrow.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng nǐ dài bǐ lái shàngkè.
exampleSentences.english: Please bring a pen to class.
When you go to the park, take some water.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba dài wǒ qù tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: Dad takes me to play soccer.
They are rabbits.
They are very cute.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 那兩隻小狗很餓，牠們在叫。
exampleSentences.pinyin: nà liǎng zhī xiǎogǒu hěn è,tāmen zài jiào.
exampleSentences.english: Those two puppies are hungry, they're barking.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiǎoniǎo zài shù shàng,tāmen chàng gē.
exampleSentences.english: The birds are in the tree, they're singing.
We're going for a walk.
I take a walk every day.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hé bàba qù gōngyuán sànbù.
exampleSentences.english: Dad and I go for a walk in the park.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 晚飯後，我們帶狗去散步。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnfàn hòu,wǒmen dài gǒu qù sànbù.
exampleSentences.english: After dinner, we take the dog for a walk.

words.definition: (particle used after a verb to indicate past experience)

exampleSentences.english: I have been to the park.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ kàn guo zhè běn shū ma?
exampleSentences.english: Have you read this book?
I have ridden the school bus before.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ qù guo hǎitān,hěn hǎo wán.
exampleSentences.english: I've been to the beach, it was lots of fun.
I was six last year.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qùnián wǒ xué le yìdiǎn zhōngwén.
exampleSentences.english: I learnt a little Chinese last year.
We went to Japan last year.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這隻狗是去年來我家的。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè zhī gǒu shì qùnián lái wǒ jiā de.
exampleSentences.english: This dog came to our home last year.
A cat is an animal.
Where is the cat?
My cat is called Xiaohua.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnfàn shí māo zài chī yú.
exampleSentences.english: At dinnertime the cat is eating fish.
Last month was March.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngge yuè wǒmen xué le shùzì.
exampleSentences.english: Last month we learnt numbers.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngge yuè wǒmen qù le hǎibiān.
exampleSentences.english: We went to the beach last month.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shàngge yuè wǒ de yáchǐ diào le.
exampleSentences.english: My tooth fell out last month.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yǎng le yì zhī māo.
exampleSentences.english: I keep a cat as a pet.
What pet do you want to keep?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen jiā yǎng le yì tiáo yú.
exampleSentences.english: Our family keeps a fish.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zhǎngdà hòu xiǎng yǎng gǒu.
exampleSentences.english: When I grow up I want to keep a dog.
My book is missing.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ de bǐ bújiàn le,zài nǎlǐ?
exampleSentences.english: My pen is missing, where is it?
My toy has gone missing!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 貓不見了，我們找了很久。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māo bújiàn le,wǒmen zhǎo le hěn jiǔ.
exampleSentences.english: The cat is missing, we looked for ages.
I'm very happy.
Today is very hot.
This cake is extremely delicious.
I really want to go to the beach.
The puppy is very cute.
Your school bag is cute.
Babies look cute when they smile.
Your rabbit is so cute!
Rabbits have two ears.
Rabbits like to eat carrots.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen dài tùzi qù kàn shòuyī.
exampleSentences.english: We take the rabbit to the vet.
The little rabbit is eating grass.
Please feed the dog.
Have you fed the cat?

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnfàn hòu,wǒ bāng māma wèi gǒu.
exampleSentences.english: After dinner, I help Mum feed the dog.
We feed the ducks by the lake.
